text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's do this! Here at this pool, 
I'm gonna prove that I'm number one in 
having fun, too!

text_block_list.name: Friend A
text_block_list.text:
Wait, Scarlet, we came here just to hang 
out, so why are you wearing a school 
swimsuit?!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Because this isn't just hanging out. Today 
is—a match!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I'm not quite sure what's going on, but 
I'll join in too, Scarlet-san!

In order to show off her polished 
reactions, Daiwa Scarlet began to play 
around with utmost seriousness.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Kyaaaa, no way, stooop♪ The water's so 
cooold♪

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Gaaah, is that water slide really that 
high up~?!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant*... How was that, Spe-san? Did 
I pull off a reaction that's both funny 
and totally natural?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Yup, yup! I don't really get it, but 
you're doing great!

text_block_list.name: Friend B
text_block_list.text:
Hey, shouldn't we get something to eat 
soon? Excuse me~! One 'Fluffy White 
Frappe', please!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Food... I'll have the extra-large curry 
and a jumbo shio ramen...

text_block_list.name: Friend A
text_block_list.text: Whoa, you're eating that much?!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I'm abnormally hungry... Having fun isn't 
just child's play, you know.

text_block_list.name: Friend A
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... Hey, isn't she way more desperate 
than usual today?

text_block_list.name: Friend B
text_block_list.text:
You think? Honestly, her being desperate 
feels pretty standard to me.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Scarlet-san, look over there! They're 
holding a swimsuit dance contest!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
A dance contest... That's the perfect 
chance to prove that I have the most fun!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's do this! Let's jump in, 
Spe-san!

text_block_list.name: Male Spectator
text_block_list.text:
Wahahaha, what's with that girl?! Look, 
the one in the school swimsuit!

text_block_list.name: Female Spectator
text_block_list.text:
Why does she have such a grim scowl on her 
face?! Oh man, that's hilarious!!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
(Yes, I did it...! Everyone is 
acknowledging how much fun I am!)

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet

text_block_list.text: —And so, the day came to an end.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Good work today! Scarlet-san, and everyone 
else too, today was so much fun!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
So, what did you all think? Was I funny 
and entertaining today?

text_block_list.name: Friend B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, it was super entertaining! Just like 
always♪

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Just like always? Not completely 
different from usual?

text_block_list.name: Friend B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. No matter how small the thing is, 
you're always giving it your absolute all. 
We never get tired of watching you.

text_block_list.name: Friend A
text_block_list.text:
Well, you were especially wild today, 
though. Let's all hang out again♪

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer-san from the other day. What a 
coincidence.
choice_data_list:
On your way back from hanging out 
somewhere?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I gave it my absolute all so nobody 
would think I'm boring, but...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
It turns out the everyday me wasn't as 
boring of a girl as I'd thought.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
All that hard work definitely felt 
rewarded, so I guess I just have to keep 
tackling every single thing head-on at 
this rate!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Thanks a lot for hearing me out. Well 
then, see you around!

She walks away with a refreshing smile. 
Her face, radiant and full of life— could 
never be considered that of a boring girl.

text_block_list.name: Friend B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, she was weirdly fired up, wasn't 
she? Which made the whole thing pretty 
hilarious.

text_block_list.name: Friend A
text_block_list.text:
Was she always someone who let loose like 
that?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Scarlet-san is actually someone who 
can let loose way more than that!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Just the other day when she fought with 
Vodka-san, she was dual-wielding slippers 
and...—!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Waaaah, Spe-san, don't say another word! 
Stooop!

Her panicked shout echoes across the area. 
It seems taking things so seriously ended 
up creating a strangely surreal kind of 
comedy.
